title: coord.py put needs no holder token, so any agent can overwrite the value of a key another agent has claimed
goal: SP-rsmmwzr2 review G9 (ST-5iwikc3n): put takes no token, so anyone who reads the revision with get can put a new value on a key whose lease another agent holds; gate g2 allowed put to raise the revision on a leased key but not without the holder. Asked as a gate first: a put on a leased key needs the holder's --token, or kb/_self/tools.md says the lease does not guard the value (then this repro is rewritten).

run:
import json,os,socket,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,time
T='_tools/coord.py'
D=tempfile.mkdtemp()
E=dict(os.environ,KB_COORD_STORE=os.path.join(D,'c.db'))
def c(*a,t=30):
    p=s.run([sys.executable,T,*a],capture_output=True,text=True,env=E,timeout=t);return p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr
c('claim','K5','--ttl','60','--holder','a')
r=c('put','K5','--value','hijack','--revision','1')[0]
print('put on a leased key without its token exit',r);sys.exit(0 if r!=0 else 1)
